html.textSample: HTTP Forever — A reliably insecure connection HTTP Forever A reliably insecure connection http:// httpforever.com 01 — The idea Why does this site exist? This domain started out as my personal captive portal buster , but I wanted to publicise it for anyone to use. If you're on a train, in a hotel or bar, on a flight, or anywhere that makes you log in for WiFi, this site can help you get to the log
